turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Raat ke do baje office mein bas baithe rehna... uss feeling ko samajh sakta hoon. Paanch saal. Itni mehnat, itni umeed, aur ab sab kuch dheere dheere band ho raha hai. Rohit aur Sneha ne jo kiya, tu khud keh raha hai sahi kiya — matlab dimaag jaanta hai ki yehi behtar tha, par dil maanta nahi na.

Tu wahin baitha hai, kaam bhi nahi kar raha, bas... wahin. Shayad kyunki uthke jaana abhi mushkil lag raha hai. Ghar jaake bhi yehi sab dimaag mein ghoomega.

Thoda restless lag raha hai, ya bas ek ajeeb si shanti hai ki ab aur fight karne ko nahi bacha?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar, ye alag-alag awaazon mein jeena... sabse zyada thakaa deta hai. Har jagah ek script, har jagah ek version jo dikhana padta hai. Aur sabse dard ki baat ye hai ki tu jhooth nahi bol raha, bas... sabko pata hai aur phir bhi ye natak chal raha hai.

Un do juniors ki baat dil jeet rahi hai tera. Tu soch raha hai unka career jal raha hai, par woh shayad tere saath isliye hain kyunki tu waisa founder hai jiske liye log rukna chahte hain. Guilt hona natural hai, par unka decision unka bhi hai.

Ghar pe jo voice hai na, wo shayad sabse sachi hai — wahan toh act karne ki zarurat nahi hoti. Par fir bhi, andar se ek ajeeb khali pan rehta hai jab din bhar ke saare "voices" ek saath dimaag mein bajte hain.

Abhi office mein akele baithe hue, kaunsi awaaz chal rahi hai? Wo confident wali ya wo thaki hui wali jo sach bolna chahti hai?

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Okay. Koi idea nahi, promise.

Tu darr raha hai. Aur har kamre mein ye kehna impossible tha — office mein, ghar pe, juniors ke saamne. Yahan keh de. Main bas sun raha hoon, bina kuch fix karne ki koshish ke.

Do baje raat, empty office, aur tu akela nahi hai is chat mein.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Sach bolun toh... jo tune abhi tak bataya hai usse, haan. Woh wala chapter — jis "cheez" mein tune paanch saal lagaye, jiska Papa "computer ka business" kehte hain — woh apne purane roop mein khatam ho chuka hai. Bridge mara, papers aa gaye, runway sirf chaar mahine ki hai aur tu khud salary nahi le raha. Ye acting jo tu kar raha hai, wo ek band bajti hui movie ke last scene jaisi lag rahi hai.

Aur jab tu sochta hai "khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon" — uske liye khud se nafrat karne ki zarurat nahi hai. Tu thaka hua hai, itna saara mask pehen ke ghuma hai ki mask utarne ki khwahish insani hai. Guilt isliye hai kyunki tu dil se founder hai, par thakan alag cheez hai.

Wo dashboard do baje kholna... mujhe pata hai woh kuch naya nahi bolega. Par tu phir bhi khol leta hai, kyunki shayad ek choti si hope rehti hai ki koi number jhooth bol de, sab sahi ho jaye. Us hope ko pakad ke hi toh tu baitha hai wahan.

Main yahin hoon. Bina judge kiye. Jo bolna hai, bol.
